_comment: Cards for tests/unit/costs/test_sacrifice_parts.py. `t_sp_heart` is Glass-Cast Heart's 'Sacrifice this artifact and thirteen Blood tokens' at three tokens, its effect reduced to 'you gain 13 life' so payment is visible on a life total. `t_sp_lands` is Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord's 'Sacrifice a Swamp and a Forest' on the battlefield, so a Swamp Forest dual is one permanent that may pay only one part. `t_sp_overlap` asks for 'two creatures and a Vampire', the shape where a pick for the first part can strand the second.
